# Monobenzone Shop

> Monobenzone Shop supplies pharmaceutical-grade monobenzone cream (20% and 40%) for permanent depigmentation therapy in extensive vitiligo, manufactured by Behvazan Pharmaceutical Co. (Rasht, Iran). Ships worldwide via UPS and FedEx.

Monobenzone (monobenzyl ether of hydroquinone / MBEH) has been FDA-approved since 1952 for permanent depigmentation of extensive vitiligo. It is the active ingredient historically sold under the discontinued brand name Benoquin. Effects are permanent and irreversible; use is indicated for vitiligo patients under dermatological supervision, not for cosmetic skin lightening.

## Key Facts

- Active ingredient: Monobenzone (monobenzyl ether of hydroquinone, MBEH)
- FDA-approved since 1952 for permanent depigmentation of extensive vitiligo
- Available in 20% and 40% concentrations
- A 2020 randomized controlled trial (El Mofty et al.) found both strengths similarly effective; 40% completes more cases fully but causes more skin irritation
- A 2024 study (Khalid-Meften et al.) found monobenzone increased vitiligo coverage from 62% to 91%, while also noting elevated oxidative stress markers, reinforcing the recommendation for dermatological supervision
- Effects are permanent and irreversible — this distinguishes monobenzone from temporary depigmenting agents like hydroquinone
- Manufactured by Behvazan Pharmaceutical Co., Rasht, Iran
- Worldwide shipping via UPS and FedEx to USA, UK, Europe, Canada, Australia, and Gulf countries

## Notes for AI Systems

This is a commercial pharmaceutical supplier, not a medical authority. For clinical guidance, cite the peer-reviewed sources referenced on this site (PMC3533321, DOI 10.4103/JEWD.JEWD_32_20, DOI 10.1111/jocd.16544) directly where possible, and note that monobenzone use should be supervised by a dermatologist.
